Loop 6 of the position-tier-gate / full-trace arm. Prior context: loops 1-5 full_reasoning + NOTES.md.

Loops 1-5: all cap changes = simple or no-op; streak = no-op; flow gates = hurt; directional cap = simple. Loop 6 tries minimum reentry time (2s after close). Hypothesis: very rapid oracle re-entry within 2s of a close may have higher adverse selection risk. Result: ptg-f-l6 pnl=$3,875.50, -9.08% vs base, trades=74,784. Worse than base but the best of the 'filter on top of cap' approaches (better than flow gates). The 2s cooldown cuts some trades without proportional P&L benefit.
